description: Source code for ApkFileProvider class, a ContentProvider implementation for sharing APK files via content URIs in an Android app.

classes.name: ApkFileProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that provides access to APK files for sharing via content URIs.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Constructs a content URI for the given package name.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to send the APK file associated with the package name.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens a ParcelFileDescriptor for the APK file specified by the URI.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns metadata about the APK file as a Cursor.

methods.name: getApplicationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves ApplicationInfo for the package name extracted from the URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub method for delete operation, returns 0.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns MIME type for APK files.

methods.name: getTypeAnonymous
methods.description: Returns MIME type for APK files (same as getType).

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Stub method for insert operation, returns null.
